_notes: General-knowledge tourism layer, kept separate from the hotel's own confirmed facts in knowledge_base.json. Every record below is tagged 'confidence: general_tourism_info' to tell the model this is public destination knowledge (from regional tourism sources), not something the hotel itself publishes or operates — so it should be shared as helpful local-area context, never as a hotel-confirmed fact, and never used to book/quote anything the hotel doesn't run. Hotel-run tour products (Kyamunene Water Fall, Burigi/Chato/Serengeti National Parks) stay in knowledge_base.json's 'tour' section, since those the hotel actually confirms and sells.

attractions.name: Musira Island
attractions.description: A rocky island just offshore from Bukoba town, once used as a royal-era prison island. A path leads to the summit past an old Orthodox church; the far side has cliffs and caves.
attractions.directions_from_hotel: The hotel sits about 200m from the Lake Victoria shore in Bukoba town. Boats to Musira leave from the Nyamukazi landing, a short distance along the shore near Kagera Museum — walkable or a very short taxi/boda ride from the hotel.
attractions.confidence: general_tourism_info — boat fees/times change; the hotel's tour or car-hire desk can help arrange a boat

attractions.name: Kagera Museum
attractions.description: A small regional museum with Haya and other local tribal artefacts, crafts, and wildlife photography from the Kagera region.
attractions.directions_from_hotel: In the Nyamukazi area near Bukoba Airport, on the lakeshore side of town — a short drive or walk from the hotel.
attractions.confidence: general_tourism_info — opening hours/entry fee not published by the hotel; confirm locally before visiting

attractions.name: Bunena Church
attractions.description: Bukoba's original cathedral, built in 1914 — the oldest church in town, with a scenic lakeside setting.
attractions.directions_from_hotel: On the Bukoba lakeshore, a short distance from the town centre and from the hotel.

attractions.name: Katuruka Heritage Site
attractions.description: Preserves one of the oldest known iron-smelting furnace sites in East, Central, and Southern Africa, dated to roughly 500 BC.
attractions.directions_from_hotel: A short drive outside Bukoba town; a local guide or tour operator is recommended.

attractions.name: Mater Misericordiae Cathedral
attractions.description: A landmark cathedral in central Bukoba, known for its tall glass steeple.
attractions.directions_from_hotel: Central Bukoba town, within easy reach of the hotel.

attractions.name: Rubondo Island National Park
attractions.description: A Lake Victoria island national park protecting chimpanzees, sitatunga antelope, and other wildlife — a bigger excursion than the town-area sites above.
attractions.directions_from_hotel: Further afield than the other attractions here; reached by boat or light aircraft, best planned as a multi-day trip arranged in advance.
attractions.confidence: general_tourism_info — best discussed with the hotel's tour desk given the extra planning involved

how_to_reach_bukoba.by_air: Bukoba Airport (BKZ) is roughly a 10-minute drive from the town centre and the hotel.
how_to_reach_bukoba.by_lake_ferry: The MV Victoria ferry sails overnight between Bukoba and Mwanza about three times a week, taking around 12 hours — a scenic, low-cost route across Lake Victoria.
how_to_reach_bukoba.by_road: Long-haul buses connect Bukoba to Mwanza, Dar es Salaam, and other Tanzanian cities; the main bus terminal is in central Bukoba, close to the hotel.
how_to_reach_bukoba.within_bukoba: Bukoba town is compact and largely walkable; the hotel is on Pwani Street near the RAS Kagera office, about 200m from the Lake Victoria shore.
how_to_reach_bukoba.confidence: general_tourism_info — exact schedules and fares change; the hotel's front desk or car-hire desk can help confirm current options
